answer: Each agent commits its identity in the Semaphore tree, deposits bonded stake, and uses an epoch-specific polynomial to prove rate-limit compliance without disclosing its key. A nebula of valid proofs can remain private, but duplicate messaging at the same rate-limit point exposes two polynomial evaluations; interpolation reconstructs the Shamir-shared secret, enabling verification and instantaneous collateral slashing.
